reason: Check compact menu hierarchy, dialog consistency, accessibility, Escape handling, and focus restoration.
Check exact repository routing, ref invalidation, write locking, and post-action refreshes.
Check bridge symmetry, structured ref compatibility, blocker unions, and absence of unsafe casts.
Check viewport clamping, fixed popup behavior, lint/type/build quality, and layout regressions.
Check validation and error ownership at every Git data/action boundary.
Check that existing dialogs, clipboard feedback, and store helpers were reused without speculative abstractions.
Check implementation against researched Git semantics, known parser risks, and required test scenarios.
